browser.readyDescription: Ask any session to use this browser (or open another one) to complete tasks like research, form filling, QA checks, or data extraction.
browser.readyTitle: This browser is ready for your Agents - and you ;)
browser.safetyHint: Robb Agents only control browser windows when you ask them to.
transport.networkError: Could not connect to {{url}}. Is the remote server running?
transport.protocolMismatch: Protocol mismatch between client and server versions.
transport.timeout: Connection to {{url}} timed out. Server may be unreachable.
webui.connectingDescription: Establishing a secure connection to your Robb host…
webui.hostResetDesktopOnly: Host reset is available only in the desktop app. Signing out of Remote does not delete host data.
webui.hostUnavailableDescription: The internet is available, but the host did not respond. Check that Robb Agents and Remote are running on your computer.
webui.localEraseFailedAfterLogout: You are signed out, but this browser could not fully erase its local offline data.
webui.logOutFailed: Sign-out failed. Your session is still active.
webui.offlineActionFailed: The action could not be completed. Review the current local state before trying again.
webui.offlineBackOnline: Back online · Nothing will be sent without your confirmation
webui.offlineClearConfirm: This removes snapshots, pins, drafts, and outbox items from this device. It does not delete host conversations.
webui.offlineContextChanged: The conversation changed since this message was prepared.
webui.offlineContextReviewRequired: The live conversation changed. Review it again before sending.
webui.offlineDeleteOutboxConfirm: Delete this unsent item from this device?
webui.offlineDeliveryUncertain: Delivery is uncertain. This item cannot be retried here; check the live conversation, then delete it or recompose manually.
webui.offlineDescription: Reconnect this device to the internet. Robb Agents will resume automatically when your host is reachable.
webui.offlineDraftDescription: Draft text is saved locally. Adding it to the outbox still will not send it.
webui.offlineDraftPlaceholder: Write a message to review later…
webui.offlineDraftReviewDescription: Review this local text before adding it to the outbox.
webui.offlineEmptyTranscript: This saved snapshot does not contain displayable text.
webui.offlineEnableOnlineFirst: Reconnect once to enable encrypted offline access on this device.
webui.offlineEnableRequiresConnection: Connect to the host before enabling offline storage.
webui.offlineNoSearchResults: No saved conversation matches this search.
webui.offlineNoSnapshots: No conversation snapshot is available yet. Connect once to synchronize recent text.
webui.offlineOptInDescription: With your permission, Robb can keep an encrypted text-only copy of up to 10 recent conversations on this device.
webui.offlineOptInEncrypted: Saved free text is encrypted locally. Structured file, credential, tool, and authentication fields stay excluded, but text you wrote may itself contain sensitive information.
webui.offlineOptInOutbox: Messages prepared offline are never sent automatically. You review each one after reconnecting.
webui.offlineOutboxDescription: These items remain on this device until you send or delete them, or until the {{count}}-day retention period ends.
webui.offlineOutboxFull: The offline outbox is full. Send or delete an item before adding another.
webui.offlineOutboxOnlineDescription: Review every item against the current conversation, then send it manually.
webui.offlinePrivacy: The public app cache contains no private data. Opt-in free text is encrypted separately; structured file, credential, tool, and authentication fields stay excluded, but saved text can itself be sensitive.
webui.offlineSelectConversationDescripti: Available text will open here in read-only mode.
webui.offlineSendBlocked: The host is not ready to accept this message.
webui.offlineSessionBusy: Wait for the agent to finish before reviewing this item.
webui.offlineSessionMissing: This conversation no longer exists on the host.
webui.offlineStorageNotice: Private offline content stays in encrypted browser storage, separate from the public PWA asset cache.
webui.offlineSyncFailed: The offline copy could not be synchronized. Your saved local work was not sent or deleted.
webui.offlineUncertainReviewDetail: Open the live conversation and verify delivery. This item cannot be retried automatically.
webui.remoteConnectedTo: This device is securely paired with {{host}}.
webui.remoteFilesStayLocal: Files and credentials stay on the host
webui.remoteInstallBrowserInstructions: Open your browser menu, then choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
webui.remoteInstallIosInstructions: In Safari, tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”, enable “Open as Web App”, and tap Add.
webui.remotePairAutomatic: Confirming the secure pairing from your QR code…
webui.remotePairDescription: Scan the QR code shown by Robb Agents on your computer, or enter its one-time code.
webui.remotePairingCreateFailed: Unable to create a pairing code.
webui.remoteRequiresInternet: Pairing requires an internet connection to your Robb host.
webui.remoteSetupDescription: Scan this code with your phone. Robb Agents keeps running on this computer while you work remotely.
